name: Qx Bing Wallpaper
description: Browse Bing's daily images in a native Qx thumbnail list, then download or set them as wallpaper.

descriptions.en: Browse Bing's daily images, download them, or set them as wallpaper.
descriptions.zh-CN: 浏览必应每日图片，下载图片或将其设为壁纸。

author: Qx

preferences.label: Apply Wallpaper To
preferences.description: macOS: apply to every desktop or only the current desktop.

descriptions.en: macOS: apply to every desktop or only the current desktop.
descriptions.zh-CN: macOS：应用到所有桌面或仅当前桌面。

preferences.label: Download Directory
preferences.description: Folder used by the Download action.

descriptions.en: Folder used by the Download action.
descriptions.zh-CN: 下载操作使用的文件夹。

preferences.label: Daily Wallpaper
preferences.description: Choose whether the daily background task uses the latest or a random Bing image.

descriptions.en: Choose whether the daily background task uses the latest or a random Bing image.
descriptions.zh-CN: 选择每日任务使用最新图片还是随机图片。

commands.name: set-random-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Random Bing Wallpaper
commands.description: Set a random recent Bing wallpaper now.

descriptions.en: Set a random recent Bing wallpaper now.
descriptions.zh-CN: 立即设置一张近期随机必应壁纸。

commands.name: set-latest-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Latest Bing Wallpaper
commands.description: Set the latest Bing wallpaper now.

descriptions.en: Set the latest Bing wallpaper now.
descriptions.zh-CN: 立即设置最新必应壁纸。

commands.name: daily-wallpaper
commands.title: Daily Bing Wallpaper
commands.description: Apply the configured Bing wallpaper once per day.

descriptions.en: Apply the configured Bing wallpaper once per day.
descriptions.zh-CN: 每天应用一次配置的必应壁纸。
